Justin Strommen, a proud graduate of Brigham Young University (BYU), has spent much of his life in Indiana and Utah. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and minored in Ballroom Dance. Justin is a disciple of Christ, software developer, and volunteer musician dedicated to discovering universal principles through continuous learning and applying them to his faith, career, hobbies, and relationships.

Justin's experiences at BYU brought his technical and artistic passions together, centered on the teachings of Jesus Christ. He exercises faith in His Savior by volunteering his time, resources, and diverse talents to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Demonstrating hope in the living Christ's gift of eternal relationships, Justin consistently communicates through prayer with his Heavenly Father, learns from ancient scripture, and keeps a clean, organized home that fosters harmony. He strives to exercise charity by teaching eternal principles in dedicated settings and through his everyday example.

Professionally, Justin has experience in software development and cloud-based technical solutions. He is passionate about technology, particularly object-oriented design and cloud architecture, and constantly seeks to learn new things as he diligently applies past principles he's learned.

Beyond his professional life, Justin is an avid supporter of the arts. He plays the viola, enjoys casual music composition, and plans to master many new instruments, including the harp & piano. Among outdoor activities, he enjoys consistent walks and the occasional hike. Additionally, Justin explores fantasy concepts through board games, anime, and Nintendo/PC gaming.
Feel free to explore his site, connect with him, or drop a message. He looks forward to connecting with you!
